product_one_liner.value: Aurora Solar provides cloud-based software that helps solar professionals design, sell, and permit residential and commercial solar projects.
product_one_liner.notes: Aurora’s job posting describes its software as serving solar professionals and supporting solar companies in selling, designing, and installing residential and commercial projects; the About page also describes its solar platform. This supports the concise product and audience description.

pricing_page.notes: Aurora Solar has a public page titled Pricing that presents plans, satisfying the criterion even where a plan may require custom pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Solaris Renewables case study says Aurora Solar worked with Solaris, and the Kasselman Solar case-study page identifies Kasselman Solar as the customer featured in its success story. | named_customers.0: The Aurora Solar case study names Solaris Renewables as the organization Aurora worked with. | named_customers.1: The cited Kasselman Solar case-study page presents Kasselman Solar as a customer success story with Aurora Solar.

employee_band.notes: The latest dated employee-count evidence reports 302 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band. Other estimates vary, so the band is based on the recent dated 302 count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Aurora Solar’s news page states that the company is headquartered in San Francisco. | hq_country: The Aurora Solar company profile identifies its location country as the United States and its city as San Francisco.

founded_year.notes: Aurora Solar’s About page says it was founded in August 2013, establishing the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s Engineering-filtered blog index lists technical AI posts. Two are explicitly technical (AI-assisted performance work and GAN-versus-diffusion models), and each identifies Adriel Luo as a Senior Computer Vision Engineer, meeting the threshold of at least two engineer-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: Aurora’s public developer documentation has multiple tutorials across project information, roof models, energy production, assets, pricing, plan sets, and tenant settings, along with a separately linked API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board is open and lists positions; the surfaced titles include Senior Software Engineer, Computation, Staff Analytics Engineer, and Account Executive, while the department summary shows ordinary software engineering, finance, sales operations, operations, business analytics, and account executive roles rather than an AI/ML or data-science title. Analytics Engineer does not qualify under the stated rule.

model_provider.notes: Aurora Solar’s Trust Center subprocessors page lists Anthropic and OpenAI as AI Services subprocessors. The page does not specify particular model names, so the answer names the disclosed providers.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center compliance page names SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS (SAQ A 4.0), and GDPR; these are the requested named certifications/frameworks included in the answer. | compliance_certs.0: The compliance page expressly names SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance page expressly names PCI DSS and SAQ A 4.0. | compliance_certs.2: The compliance page expressly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile names the latest round as Series D. | funding_date: The profile dates Aurora Solar’s latest funding round to February 2022, represented as YYYY-MM. | funding_amount_usd: The company profile identifies the latest round amount as USD 200,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The company profile identifies February 2022 as the most recent funding round, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; therefore it did not raise in the specified period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Aurora’s current careers posting is a full-time Mid-Market Account Executive role in the Sales Account Executive department.

launched_6mo.notes: Aurora announced platform updates on September 22, 2026, including new capabilities and the product’s UK availability, within the six-month window preceding November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Aurora’s Trust Center subprocessor list identifies HubSpot as a CRM and marketing service and Salesforce as a CRM and sales/account-management service. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Trust Center identifies HubSpot as a CRM and marketing subprocessor. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Trust Center identifies Salesforce as a CRM and sales/account-management subprocessor.
